identified_savings_open.title: Identified monthly savings (open + in progress, exclude hidden)
identified_savings_open.esql:
FROM logs-finops.rightsizing-*
| WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 14 days
  AND finops.rightsizing.status IN ("open", "in_progress")
| STATS recs = COUNT_DISTINCT(finops.rightsizing.id),
        identified_usd = SUM(finops.rightsizing.estimated_monthly_savings)
    BY finops.rightsizing.action, cloud.account.id
| SORT identified_usd DESC

captured_savings_done.title: Captured savings (done only — do not add to identified)
captured_savings_done.esql:
FROM logs-finops.rightsizing-*
| WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 90 days
  AND finops.rightsizing.status == "done"
| STATS recs = COUNT_DISTINCT(finops.rightsizing.id),
        captured_usd = SUM(COALESCE(finops.rightsizing.realized_savings, finops.rightsizing.estimated_monthly_savings))
    BY cloud.account.id, finops.rightsizing.action
| SORT captured_usd DESC

action_queue.title: Recommended actions (visible queue)
action_queue.esql:
FROM logs-finops.rightsizing-*
| WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 14 days
  AND finops.rightsizing.status IN ("open", "in_progress")
| KEEP @timestamp, finops.rightsizing.action, finops.rightsizing.finding,
       finops.rightsizing.current_type, finops.rightsizing.recommended_type,
       finops.rightsizing.estimated_monthly_savings, finops.rightsizing.performance_risk,
       finops.rightsizing.resource_arn, finops.rightsizing.owner, finops.rightsizing.case_id,
       cloud.account.id, cloud.region
| SORT finops.rightsizing.estimated_monthly_savings DESC

hidden_infeasible.title: Hidden / infeasible (not in open KPIs)
hidden_infeasible.esql:
FROM logs-finops.rightsizing-*
| WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 14 days
  AND finops.rightsizing.status == "hidden"
| STATS recs = COUNT_DISTINCT(finops.rightsizing.id),
        parked_usd = SUM(finops.rightsizing.estimated_monthly_savings)
    BY finops.rightsizing.hidden_reason, cloud.account.id

status_summary.title: Pipeline: open / hidden / in progress / done
status_summary.esql:
FROM logs-finops.rightsizing-*
| WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 14 days
| STATS recs = COUNT_DISTINCT(finops.rightsizing.id),
        estimated_usd = SUM(finops.rightsizing.estimated_monthly_savings),
        realized_usd = SUM(finops.rightsizing.realized_savings)
    BY finops.rightsizing.status
| SORT recs DESC

ec2_evidence.title: Utilization evidence for actions-runner (paste another instance id as needed)
ec2_evidence.esql:
FROM metrics-aws.ec2_metrics-*
| WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 14 days
  AND cloud.instance.id == "i-09c920d4ff962442f"
| STATS cpu_avg = AVG(aws.ec2.metrics.CPUUtilization.avg),
        cpu_p95 = PERCENTILE(aws.ec2.metrics.CPUUtilization.avg, 95),
        latest = MAX(@timestamp)
    BY cloud.instance.id, cloud.account.id, cloud.instance.name, cloud.machine.type

low_cpu_waste.title: Lowest CPU instances (waste evidence, not a Compute Optimizer rec)
low_cpu_waste.esql:
FROM metrics-aws.ec2_metrics-*
| WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 14 days
| STATS cpu_avg = AVG(aws.ec2.metrics.CPUUtilization.avg),
        cpu_p95 = PERCENTILE(aws.ec2.metrics.CPUUtilization.avg, 95)
    BY cloud.instance.id, cloud.instance.name, cloud.machine.type, cloud.account.id
| WHERE cpu_avg < 5
| SORT cpu_avg ASC
| LIMIT 15

filterlogevents_quota.title: CloudWatch FilterLogEvents CallCount vs 5 TPS account quota
filterlogevents_quota.esql:
FROM metrics-aws.cloudwatch_metrics-*
| WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 1 day
  AND aws.cloudwatch.namespace == "AWS/Usage"
  AND aws.dimensions.Resource == "FilterLogEvents"
| STATS calls = SUM(aws.usage.metrics.CallCount.sum)
    BY cloud.account.id
| SORT calls DESC

service_dod.title: SERVICE + account day-over-day spike candidates
service_dod.esql:
FROM metrics-aws.billing-default
| WHERE aws.billing.group_definition.key == "SERVICE"
| STATS daily = SUM(aws.billing.UnblendedCost.amount) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 day), aws.billing.group_by.SERVICE, cloud.account.id
| STATS latest = LAST(daily, day), prev_sum = SUM(daily), n = COUNT(daily)
    BY aws.billing.group_by.SERVICE, cloud.account.id
| EVAL baseline = (prev_sum - latest) / (n - 1)
| WHERE n >= 4 AND latest > baseline * 1.5 AND latest > 100
| SORT latest DESC
| LIMIT 20

kpi_rule: Never add identified_usd and captured_usd into one number.
